name: dsh-stats-panel
description: dsh-external in-box dsh bundle: session stats panel. Hovering the StatsLine strip under the composer pops a bottom-sheet visualization (turns/steps, TTFT avg, decode speed, LLM/tool-call time split, input/output token bars, cache-hit ring) replacing the upstream plain-text tooltip. Zero-intrusion: DOM text parsing, zh/en dual duration formats.
